stocks.name: Nairobi Securities Exchange PLC
stocks.description: Nairobi Securities Exchange PLC is the primary stock exchange of Kenya, providing a secondary market for equity and debt securities and offering clearing and settlement services.

stocks.name: Bamburi Cement PLC
stocks.description: Bamburi Cement PLC is the leading cement manufacturing and marketing company in the Eastern Africa region and a key subsidiary of the Holcim Group. The company operates integrated cement plants and grinding stations in Kenya and Uganda, providing critical materials for large-scale infrastructure projects and residential construction.

stocks.name: Africa Mega Agricorp PLC
stocks.description: Africa Mega Agricorp PLC is a primary agricultural producer listed on the Nairobi Securities Exchange, specializing in integrated crop management, large-scale horticulture, and the export of premium Kenyan tea and coffee to international markets.

stocks.name: Kenya Electricity Generating Company PLC
stocks.description: Kenya Electricity Generating Company PLC (KenGen) is the leading electric power generation company in Kenya, producing approximately 70% of the electricity consumed in the country through a diverse portfolio including hydro, geothermal, wind, and thermal energy.

stocks.name: Shri Krishna Overseas PLC
stocks.description: Shri Krishna Overseas PLC is a diversified agricultural firm listed on the NSE Growth Enterprise Market Segment. The company specializes in the procurement, processing, and global export of tea, pulses, and grain commodities from East Africa.

stocks.name: Umeme Limited
stocks.description: Umeme Limited is Uganda's leading electricity distribution company, cross-listed on the Nairobi Securities Exchange. The company operates a 20-year concession from the Government of Uganda for the distribution and supply of electricity, serving over 1.6 million customers across domestic and industrial segments.

stocks.name: Stanbic Holdings Plc
stocks.description: Stanbic Holdings Plc operates within the dynamic financial services sector, delivering a comprehensive suite of banking and related solutions across East Africa.

stocks.name: Sanlam Kenya PLC
stocks.description: Sanlam Kenya PLC is a leading Kenyan financial services group listed on the Nairobi Securities Exchange. It provides life and general insurance services through its subsidiaries, targeting individuals and corporate clients across the East African region.

stocks.name: Flame Tree Group Holdings Limited
stocks.description: Flame Tree Group is a diversified pan-African manufacturer and distributor of plastic storage tanks, cosmetic products, and snack foods, headquartered in Kenya and operating across the East African region.

stocks.name: ALP INDUSTRIAL REIT
stocks.description: ALP INDUSTRIAL REIT is an equity registered and traded on the NSE. Price history backfilled using automated records.

stocks.name: BK Group Plc
stocks.description: BK Group Plc is a leading Rwandan financial services group with a dominant market position in commercial banking, insurance, and investment management. It is the first Rwandan company to cross-list on the Nairobi Securities Exchange to facilitate broader regional investor participation.

stocks.name: NCBA Group PLC
stocks.description: NCBA Group PLC is a leading financial institution in East Africa, offering a comprehensive suite of banking and financial services to individuals, SMEs, and large enterprises. Core activities include retail and corporate banking, anchored by an expanding smart branch network and pioneering digital business solutions, which include mobile lending. The Group is renowned as the Home of Asset Finance in Kenya, maintaining a market-leading position. Furthermore, it operates NCBA Insurance, established following the full acquisition of AIG Kenya, and provides Investment Banking and Global Markets services. NCBA’s regional presence is robust, with operations extending across Kenya, Tanzania, Uganda, Rwanda, Côte d’Ivoire, South Sudan, and Ghana, underpinning its commitment to enabling progress across Sub-Saharan Africa.

stocks.name: Car & General (Kenya) Plc
stocks.description: Car & General (Kenya) Plc is a prominent East African distributor of automotive, power generation, and engineering equipment. The company maintains a diversified regional footprint, representing global brands such as TVS, Cummins, and Piaggio across Kenya, Uganda, Tanzania, and Rwanda.

stocks.name: Carbacid Investments Plc
stocks.description: Carbacid Investments Plc is a leading East African investment holding company specializing in the production and distribution of food-grade carbon dioxide. Operating primarily through its subsidiary Carbacid (CO2) Limited, it serves major regional clients in the beverage, brewery, and industrial sectors.

stocks.name: WPP Scangroup PLC
stocks.description: WPP Scangroup PLC is the largest marketing and communication group in Sub-Saharan Africa. Headquartered in Nairobi, Kenya, it provides comprehensive services in advertising, media investment management, marketing research, and public relations, operating under a multi-agency model as a subsidiary of WPP.

stocks.name: CIC Insurance Group Plc
stocks.description: CIC Insurance Group Plc is a leading cooperative insurance provider in East Africa, offering general, life, and asset management services. The group operates across Kenya, South Sudan, Uganda, and Malawi, serving both the cooperative movement and the broader retail market.

stocks.name: TotalEnergies Marketing Kenya Plc
stocks.description: TotalEnergies Marketing Kenya Plc is a prominent petroleum and energy distributor in Kenya, specializing in the marketing of fuels, lubricants, liquefied petroleum gas (LPG), and solar solutions through a vast retail network.

stocks.name: Eveready East Africa Limited
stocks.description: Eveready East Africa PLC is a leading provider of portable power solutions in Kenya, specialising in dry cell batteries, automotive batteries, lighting products, and household energy solutions. Founded in 1967 and headquartered in Nairobi, Kenya, Eveready is listed on the Nairobi Securities Exchange (NSE), reinforcing its status as a publicly traded company committed to delivering reliable energy solutions to consumers across East Africa.

stocks.name: Liberty Kenya Holdings Limited
stocks.description: Liberty Kenya Holdings Limited is a leading financial services group in Kenya, providing life insurance, general insurance, and investment management through its core subsidiaries, Heritage Insurance and Liberty Life Assurance.

stocks.name: TPS Eastern Africa PLC
stocks.description: TPS Eastern Africa PLC, operating under the Serena Hotels brand, is a luxury hospitality group owning and managing a collection of hotels, resorts, safari lodges, and camps across East Africa and parts of Southern Asia.

stocks.name: Express Kenya PLC
stocks.description: Express Kenya PLC is a long-standing logistics firm in Kenya specializing in sea freight, air freight, transport, and warehousing. Recently, the company has diversified into real estate development to address balance sheet pressures and operational volatility.

stocks.name: British American Tobacco Kenya Limited
stocks.description: British American Tobacco Kenya Limited is a leading tobacco company in Kenya, engaged in the manufacture and sale of cigarettes and tobacco products, with a dominant market share and a significant export footprint across East and Central Africa.

stocks.name: Eaagads Limited
stocks.description: Eaagads Limited is a Kenya-based agricultural company specializing in the cultivation and sale of coffee, operating major estates in Kiambu County.

stocks.name: Kurwitu Ventures Limited
stocks.description: Kurwitu Ventures Limited is an investment firm listed on the Nairobi Securities Exchange's Growth Enterprise Market Segment (GEMS). The company primarily targets high-growth opportunities and Sharia-compliant investment vehicles across the East African region.

stocks.name: NewGold Exchange Traded Fund
stocks.description: NewGold ETF is an investment product that tracks the spot price of gold bullion. Issued by Absa Capital, it is the first commodity-linked ETF to be listed on the Nairobi Securities Exchange, offering Kenyan investors a direct exposure to the gold market in a regulated environment.

stocks.name: Unga Group PLC
stocks.description: Unga Group PLC is a leading Kenyan manufacturer of human nutrition, animal nutrition, and animal health products, operating one of the oldest flour mills in East Africa.

stocks.name: Centum
stocks.description: Centum Investment Company Plc is a leading East African investment holding company with a diversified portfolio spanning Private Equity, Real Estate, and Marketable Securities. The company actively identifies compelling investment opportunities, deploys capital through innovative structures, and focuses on creating and growing value within its portfolio. Centum aims to monetize value through annuity income streams, shareholder loan repayments, and strategic equity exits, demonstrating a strong track record of successful divestments at a premium to asset carrying values. Its operations are concentrated in East Africa, with a strong presence in Kenya, and growing regional diversification into Uganda, Tanzania, and Rwand

stocks.name: I&M Group Plc
stocks.description: I&M Group Plc is a leading East African banking and financial services group with a significant presence in Kenya, Rwanda, Tanzania, and Mauritius. The group provides commercial banking, insurance agency, and wealth management services to corporate and retail clients.

stocks.name: Safaricom PLC
stocks.description: Safaricom is the leading telecommunications provider in East Africa and the most valuable company on the Nairobi Securities Exchange. It dominates the local market through its extensive network and the globally recognized M-PESA mobile money ecosystem. The company is currently focused on regional expansion, particularly within the Ethiopian market.

stocks.name: BOC Kenya PLC
stocks.description: BOC Kenya PLC is the leading supplier of industrial, medical, and special gases in East Africa. A subsidiary of BOC Holdings, it operates across Kenya, Uganda, and Tanzania, providing critical gas solutions to the manufacturing and healthcare sectors.

stocks.name: Sameer Africa PLC
stocks.description: Sameer Africa PLC has transitioned from its legacy tyre manufacturing business to a focus on industrial real estate and property management. Rental income from its property portfolio now serves as the primary revenue driver for the company following a significant strategic pivot.

stocks.name: Crown Paints Kenya PLC
stocks.description: Crown Paints Kenya PLC is the leading manufacturer and distributor of decorative and industrial paint products in East Africa. The company maintains a dominant market share in Kenya and operates subsidiaries in Uganda, Tanzania, and Rwanda, positioning itself as a key supplier for the regional construction and infrastructure sectors.

stocks.name: Jubilee Holdings Limited
stocks.description: Jubilee Holdings Limited is the largest multi-line insurance group in East Africa. Headquartered in Nairobi, the company provides composite insurance services including life, health, and general insurance across Kenya, Uganda, Tanzania, Burundi, and Mauritius.

stocks.name: HF Group PLC
stocks.description: HF Group PLC, formerly Housing Finance Company of Kenya, is a premier mortgage finance provider in the East African region. The company operates as a non-operating holding company for subsidiaries engaged in mortgage lending, commercial banking, insurance agency, and real estate development through its flagship brands HFC Limited and HF Development and Investments.

stocks.name: Williamson Tea Kenya PLC
stocks.description: Williamson Tea Kenya PLC is a leading producer of high-quality tea in Kenya, operating four major estates and focusing on sustainable cultivation and manufacturing for global export markets.

stocks.name: Family Bank Plc
stocks.description: Family Bank Limited is a licensed commercial bank in Kenya founded in 1984 as Family Finance Building Society Ltd. Since then, it has grown into one of the country's leading financial institutions, serving over 1.3 million customers through a network of 96 branches across 32 counties, supported by over 5,000 banking agents and 103,000 merchants nationwide. Since its conversion into a commercial bank in 2007, the Bank has remained committed to advancing financial inclusion by providing accessible and affordable financial solutions, particularly to retail customers and Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises.

stocks.name: Sasini Limited
stocks.description: Sasini PLC, established in 1952, is one of Kenya’s primary food and beverage producers, listed on the Nairobi Securities Exchange. The Group’s principal activities include the growing, processing, and sale of key agricultural commodities: tea, coffee, macadamia nuts, and avocado fruits. Core operations also encompass the commercial milling and trading of coffee, forestry, and value addition on related products for the local market.

stocks.name: Nation Media Group Limited
stocks.description: Nation Media Group is the largest independent media house in East and Central Africa with operations in print, broadcast, and digital media across multiple platforms.

stocks.name: Kenya Re-Insurance Corporation Ltd.
stocks.description: Kenya Re-Insurance Corporation Limited provides reinsurance services to companies in Africa, Middle East, and Asia. It offers a wide range of treaty and facultative reinsurance services for both life and non-life business segments.

stocks.name: Kakuzi PLC
stocks.description: Kakuzi PLC is a Kenya-based agricultural cultivation and manufacture company. The company's primary operations include the growing, processing, and marketing of avocados, macadamia nuts, tea, and blueberries, alongside commercial forestry and livestock farming.

stocks.name: Absa Bank Kenya PLC
stocks.description: Absa Bank Kenya PLC is a leading financial services group listed on the Nairobi Securities Exchange, providing retail, business, and investment banking services.

stocks.name: East African Cables PLC
stocks.description: East African Cables PLC is an NSE-listed manufacturer and distributor of electrical cables serving East and Central Africa.

stocks.name: East African Breweries
stocks.description: East African Breweries PLC (EABL) operates within the dynamic branded alcoholic beverage and adult non-alcoholic drinks (ANADs) sector, making it a comprehensive “total adult beverage” (TAB) company.

stocks.name: Britam Holdings Plc
stocks.description: Britam Holdings Plc is a prominent diversified financial services group operating across Africa, listed on the Nairobi Securities Exchange. The Group’s extensive operations span Kenya, Uganda, Tanzania, Rwanda, South Sudan, Mozambique, and Malawi.

stocks.name: Equity Group Holdings Plc
stocks.description: Equity Group Holdings Plc (EGH) is a leading Integrated Financial Services group, headquartered in Nairobi, Kenya. The Group is strategically focused on East and Central Africa, delivering sustainable and inclusive economic empowerment across the region. As a holding company, EGH operates through subsidiaries providing banking, insurance, technology, and philanthropic services.

stocks.name: Kenya Power & Lighting Company Plc
stocks.description: The Kenya Power & Lighting Company Plc (Kenya Power) owns and operates most of the electricity transmission and distribution system in Kenya and sells electricity to over 9 million customers as of 2026.

stocks.name: KCB GROUP LTD
stocks.description: KCB Group Plc is a non-operating holding company operating in the Banking and Financial Services sector, focused primarily on the high-growth East African region.

stocks.name: Diamond Trust Bank Kenya Limited
stocks.description: Diamond Trust Bank Kenya Limited (DTB) is a leading regional banking group in East Africa, listed on the Nairobi Securities Exchange. The bank provides a comprehensive range of retail, corporate, and commercial banking services through an extensive network of branches in Kenya, Uganda, Tanzania, and Burundi.

stocks.name: Limuru Tea Plc
stocks.description: Limuru Tea Plc is a Kenya-based agricultural company engaged in the cultivation and sale of green leaf tea. The company owns significant tea plantations in Limuru and operates as a strategic supplier to major global processing entities, primarily managed via Ekaterra Tea Kenya.

stocks.name: LAPTRUST Imara I-REIT
stocks.description: LAPTRUST Imara I-REIT is a restricted closed-ended income REIT listed on the Restricted Sub-Segment of the NSE Main Investment Market.
